title: 💰 Master Motorcycle Fines & Demerit Points Matrix
summary: Taiwan traffic penalties for motorcycles follow a calibrated tier system: Minor equipment violations (helmet, cell phone) carry flat spot fines; turning, lane-discipline, and red-light infractions combine monetary fines with mandatory demerit points; dangerous maneuvers (extreme speeding ≥40 km/h, tailgating) mandate 6-month vehicle plate suspensions and safety training.

fines_table.why: Mandatory for rider and rear passenger

fines_table.violation: Operating handheld mobile phone while riding
fines_table.why: Includes texting, dialing, or viewing media
Crossing stop line during red phase

fines_table.violation: Failing to yield to pedestrian on crosswalk

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: If a motorcycle driver runs a red light and is caught on the spot, the penalties are:
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: a fine of NTD 1,800 to 5,400 and 3 demerit points
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Red light running incurs BOTH a monetary fine (NT$1,800–5,400) AND exactly 3 demerit points.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: If a motorcycle carries passengers or cargo in violation of regulations, what amount of fine will be imposed?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: A fine of NT $300 to NT $600
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Cargo dimension/weight violations carry the base tier fine of NT$300 to NT$600.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When a motor vehicle driver fails to yield to oncoming straight-through traffic when turning left at an intersection, what penalty applies?
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Turning violations without yielding to straight-through traffic carry a NT$600–$1,800 fine.

title: 🍷 Alcohol BAC Limits, DUI Escalations, Impoundment & Interlocks
summary: Taiwan enforces strict zero-tolerance for DUI with two distinct legal gates: Administrative penalties start at Breath BAC 0.15 mg/L (fines up to NT$90,000 + 1–2 yr license suspension), while Criminal prosecution begins at Breath BAC 0.25 mg/L. Refusal triggers an automatic NT$180,000 fine and instant license revocation. Adult passengers and vehicle owners face direct co-liability.

fines_table.why: Except elderly over 70 or mentally incapacitated
Vehicle towed away on the spot

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: If the blood alcohol concentration exceeds the legal limit and the driver continues to drive, resulting in a serious traffic accident, what must happen?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: The driver's license shall be revoked, and the driver shall be permanently barred from retaking the test.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: DUI resulting in serious injury or death triggers mandatory PERMANENT license revocation.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: If the motorcycle owner knowingly allows a driver to drive under the influence of alcohol, what is the penalty for the owner?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: The vehicle's license plate shall be suspended for two years, and the owner is fined the same amount as the driver.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: The vehicle owner faces the SAME fine as the drunk rider PLUS 2-year vehicle plate suspension.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: If a person drives a motor vehicle with a breath alcohol concentration of 0.15 mg/L or above, what is the minimum fine for motorcycles?
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: The base fine range for motorcycles is NT$15,000 to NT$90,000 (cars are NT$30,000 to NT$120,000).

title: 📦 Motorcycle Dimensions, Cargo Limits & Passenger Seating
summary: Motorcycle cargo and passenger limits are strictly bounded by physical vehicle geometry and weight class: Heavy motorcycles are capped at 80 kg of cargo, while light motorcycles are capped at 50 kg. Cargo must never exceed shoulder height or handlebar width, nor extend >0.5m behind the rear axle. Small light motorcycles cannot carry passengers.
key_numbers: Heavy Moto Cargo Weight: Max 80 kg
Light Moto Cargo Weight: Max 50 kg
Small Light Curb Weight: Max 70 kg

fines_table.violation: Cargo extending beyond handlebars or shoulders
Small light motorcycle carrying a passenger
fines_table.why: Small light class is strictly solo-rider
Passenger must face forward and straddle seat

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: For heavy motorcycles, the weight of items carried must not exceed:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Heavy motorcycles = 80 kg; Light motorcycles = 50 kg. Do not mix them up!

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: The curb weight of small and light motorcycles should be:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Small light motorcycles have a strict 70 kg statutory curb weight limit.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: The maximum overall height of a motorcycle shall not exceed:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Total height from ground to highest point must not exceed 2.5 meters.

title: ⚡ Speeds, Following Distances, Tire Maintenance & Mountain Riding
summary: Motorcycle speed limits default to 40 km/h on unmarked roads, 50 km/h on marked general roads, and 15 km/h across railway crossings. Safety standards mandate tire replacement after 6 years of age and minimum 0.8 mm tread depth. Proper brake lever free play (1–2 cm) and engine braking on mountain descents are required to prevent brake fade.
key_numbers: Brake Lever Free Play: 1 to 2 cm

fines_table.violation: Tread depth worn below 0.8 mm on inspection

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: It is recommended to use tires that are no more than:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Official safety regulation recommends replacing tires older than 6 years.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When inspecting the brakes of a motorcycle, how much free play should there be when lightly pulling the brake lever?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: There should be 1 to 2 cm of free play
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Brake lever free play must be 1 to 2 cm. Too tight locks wheels; too loose causes brake failure.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When a vehicle is directly cited for speeding on general roads, what conditions must be met to issue consecutive citations?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: Violation times are at least 6 minutes apart or the vehicle has passed more than one intersection
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Consecutive speeding citations on general roads require ≥ 6 minutes apart OR passing ≥ 1 intersection.

title: 🛑 Right-of-Way Hierarchy, 2-Stage Hook Turns & Overtaking
summary: Intersection right-of-way follows a strict 3-step hierarchy: 1. Branch roads yield to Main roads; 2. Left-turning vehicles yield to straight-going traffic; 3. At equal intersections, the left-side vehicle yields to the right-side vehicle. Two-stage left turns are mandatory when inner lanes prohibit motorcycles or have ≥3 fast lanes.

fines_table.violation: Failing to make mandatory two-stage left turn
fines_table.why: Direct left turn from outer lane is illegal

fines_table.violation: Riding in innermost lane marked 'No Motorcycles'
Failing to yield to vehicle inside roundabout

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: As a motorcyclist, when you make a left turn at an intersection and a vehicle from the opposite direction turns right into the same lane, who has the right of way?
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Under Taiwan amended rules, when both are turning into the same single lane, left-turning vehicle already negotiating turn goes before right-turning vehicle.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: Driving through an uncontrolled intersection with cars passing, which vehicle yields?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: The left-side vehicle should yield to the right-side vehicle, so the red car should yield to your vehicle
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: At equal unsignalized intersections, left-side vehicle must yield to the right-side vehicle.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When two vehicles meet on a steep and narrow slope, you should:
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: Downhill vehicle yields to uphill vehicle
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: On slopes, downhill vehicle has gravity advantage and must yield to uphill vehicle.

title: 🅿️ Parking Rules, Curb Colors & Distance Clearances
summary: Curb markings establish strict stopping zones: Solid Red curbs prohibit all stopping 24/7; Solid Yellow curbs prohibit parking from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM (allowing brief stops ≤ 3 min with driver in seat). Mandatory clearance zones require 5 meters from fire hydrants/stations and 10 meters from intersections, bus stops, and railway crossings.
key_numbers: Yellow Line Restricted Hours: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM

fines_table.violation: Parking on a red curb line
Parking within 10m of a bus stop or intersection
Parking within 5m of a fire hydrant

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: In cases of direct citation for illegal parking where the driver or vehicle owner is not present, how many hours must pass before consecutive citations can be issued?
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Consecutive illegal parking citations are issued every 2 HOURS if vehicle remains.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: Temporary parking regulations state that:
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: parking shall not exceed 3 minutes and the vehicle must be kept ready to move immediately
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Temporary stopping is defined as ≤ 3 minutes with vehicle ready to move.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: For a yellow 'No Parking' line, the prohibited parking time period is:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Yellow curbs prohibit parking between 7:00 AM and 8:00 PM daily.

title: 🛑 Visual Signs, Road Markings & Signal Compliance
summary: Visual pavement markings provide critical advance warning: White Diamond markings painted on the road alert riders to pedestrian crosswalks 30 meters ahead. Double Solid Yellow lines strictly prohibit crossing or overtaking. Yellow grid boxes require keeping intersections clear, and 15 cm solid white lines demarcate the road shoulder.

fines_table.violation: Stopping inside yellow grid marked box

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: What does this sign indicate?
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Symbol of vehicle tumbling off edge into water represents Wharf / Embankment.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: What does this triangular red border sign with black exclamation mark indicate?
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Warning triangle symbol represents official Vehicle Breakdown Sign.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: Regarding directional separation line, which statement is incorrect?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: If the opposing lane is clear with no oncoming vehicles, you may temporarily cross the double solid yellow line to drive
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Crossing double solid yellow lines is NEVER permitted regardless of oncoming traffic.

title: 🪖 Helmets, Exhaust Systems, Equipment & Inspections
summary: Motorcycle equipment standards require CNS-approved safety helmets with chin straps firmly buckled at all times. Exhaust systems cannot be altered in count, position, or have mufflers/catalytic converters removed. Motorcycles over 5 years old require mandatory temporary inspection prior to title transfer.
key_numbers: Stolen Fuel Fee Cutoff: 1 Day Before Theft

fines_table.violation: Helmet not worn or chin strap unfastened
fines_table.why: Applies on all roads including expressways

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: Regarding regulations on modifying motorcycle exhaust pipes, which statement is correct?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: The number and position of exhaust pipes must not be changed, and the muffler or catalytic converter must not be removed
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Exhaust pipes cannot be altered in count/position, and mufflers cannot be removed.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When refueling a motorcycle, one should:
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: turn off the engine and strictly prohibit the use of mobile phones
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Engine must be turned off and mobile phone use is strictly prohibited at gas stations.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When a motorcycle is registered as temporarily out of service, what is the maximum allowed period?
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Temporary out-of-service status cannot exceed 1 year.

title: 🩺 Emergency Trauma First Aid, CPR Protocol & Accident Scenes
summary: Accident trauma response follows the life-over-limb protocol (Call → Call 119/AED → Compressions → Airway → Breathing → Defibrillation). Adult CPR requires 30:2 ratio at 100–120 compressions/min (depth 5–6 cm). Unconscious victims with normal breathing must be placed in the Recovery Position, while choking requires Heimlich thrusts above the navel.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: Which is the correct position for external chest compressions in CPR?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: the lower half of the sternum in the center of the chest between the nipples
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Chest compressions are performed on the lower half of the sternum in the center of the chest.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When performing the Heimlich maneuver, where should the hands be clenched into a fist and placed?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: slightly above the navel and well below the xiphoid process
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Heimlich fist placement is slightly above the navel and well below the xiphoid process.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When a victim is in shock during a traffic accident, their facial color appears:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Trauma shock produces a pale face and cold extremities due to peripheral vasoconstriction.

title: 📋 Licensing Categories, Reapplication Bans, Compulsory Insurance & Admin Laws
summary: Motorcycle licensing requires candidates to be at least 18 years old and meet visual acuity standards. Failing the exam requires a 7-day waiting period; cheating results in an immediate 5-year ban. Compulsory Automobile Liability Insurance must have at least 30 days remaining validity for title transfer or vehicle inspection.
key_numbers: Minimum Age for Moto License: 18 Years Old

fines_table.violation: Failure to pay Compulsory Insurance fine

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When a driver uses a forged, altered, or fraudulently obtained driving license to drive, the penalty shall be:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Fraudulent credentials are CONFISCATED on the spot and subject to criminal forgery referral.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When applying for motorcycle title transfer or inspection, the compulsory insurance certificate must be valid for at least:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Compulsory insurance must have at least 30 days remaining validity.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: Reports of traffic violations made after how many days from the date of violation will not be processed?
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Citizen traffic reports must be submitted within 7 days of the incident date.
